entities.name: Lord Sash
entities.description: A tall, gaunt unman created by Ixidor, later disciple of Karona who betrayed her.

entities.name: Duke Waistcoat
entities.description: A short, stout unman created by Ixidor, later disciple of Karona who betrayed her.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: Creator of six unmen from his shadow, used as escape portals.

entities.name: Umbra
entities.description: The sixth unman, named by Akroma, who tracked Sash and Waistcoat and died so they could gain bodies.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: Gave Sash and Waistcoat their bodies from putty people and sent Umbra after them.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Goddess-like being who took the unmen as disciples; her powers were based on faith.

entities.name: Karona's War
entities.description: War started when Karona's power rose out of control, in which she attacked the Numena.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Came to end Karona's reign but almost lost the fight.

entities.name: Lord Macht
entities.description: Gave advice to Sash and Waistcoat on betraying Karona.

entities.name: Mirari Sword
entities.description: Sword used to pierce Karona's belly.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: Gave the unmen cockroach bodies in exchange for a promise to kill Akroma and Phage.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: Target the unmen promised to kill.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where Ixidor created his unmen.

entities.name: Eroshia
entities.description: City where Umbra found the two rogue unmen.

entities.name: Gilded Mage
entities.description: Tavern where the survivors had a beer.

events.summary: Ixidor creates six unmen as escape portals; during the fourth escape two unmen abandon him, leaving Umbra unclosed and Ixidor captured.
events.quote: two of the unmen decided they would very much like to not die and abandoned their creator

events.summary: Umbra tracks the two rogue unmen to Eroshia.
events.quote: Umbra tracked the two down in the city of Eroshia

events.summary: The unmen gain cockroach bodies from the Cabal Patriarch, which are stripped when they fail.
events.quote: the First stripped them of their cockroach bodies

events.summary: They gain human bodies at the cost of Umbra's life and are healed by Karona, who takes them as disciples.
events.quote: so she took them as her disciples

events.summary: Sash concludes Karona is magic manifest and she tests her powers, which turn out to be based on faith.
events.quote: Sash concluded that Karona was magic manifest

events.summary: Karona's War begins; Kamahl nearly loses fighting her.
events.quote: Kamahl came to bring an end to Karona's reign, but he almost lost the fight.

events.summary: On Lord Macht's advice, Sash and Waistcoat betray Karona and pierce her belly with the Mirari Sword; they survive and return to the Gilded Mage.
events.quote: pierced her belly with the Mirari Sword

relations.quote: Sash and Waistcoat were unmen - humanoids created by Ixidor .
